{{Short description|Japanese mathematician (born 1953)}}
{{BLP sources|date=December 2010}}

'''Michinori Yamashita''' (born 1953 in Japan) is a Japanese [[mathematician]] and professor at [[Rissho University]]. He studied at [[Sophia University]] under {{ill|Yukiyoshi Kawada|ja|河田敬義}} and [[Kiiti Morita]].
